run_train_one_epoch: run train_one_epoch to train a PyTorch model for one epoch with gradient clipping and EMA support
run_evaluate: run evaluate to assess a PyTorch model on a test data loader and report accuracy metrics
refactor_train_one_epoch: refactor train_one_epoch to enable mixed precision training with torch.cuda.amp.autocast instead of the hardcoded True block
review_evaluate: review evaluate function to understand how it computes Acc@1, Acc@5, and loss using CrossEntropyLoss
summarize_train_one_epoch: summarize train_one_epoch to understand its training loop with mixup augmentation, loss scaling, and metric logging
